Let me think about this carefully.

A standard set of dominoes is typically the "double-six" set, which is the most common version. In this set, tiles range from 0-0 to 6-6.

To calculate the number of pieces:
- Each tile has two ends with 0 to 6 pips
- We need all unique combinations where order doesn't matter
- This is: (7 × 8) / 2 = 28 pieces

The formula is n(n+1)/2 where n is the highest number plus one (7 in this case for 0-6).
